about_short_description.short_description: Ready Player Me develops a cross-game avatar platform for the metaverse.

product.name: Avatar Creator SDK
product.description: A software development kit that enables developers to integrate a customizable, cross-platform avatar creation system into their games or apps.

product.name: PlayerZero SDK
product.description: An SDK that allows developers to enable players to bring paid cosmetic items into their games, with monetization and technical compliance managed by Ready Player Me.

product.name: PlayerZero Platform
product.description: A player-facing portal where users can create, customize, and carry their avatars across multiple games integrated with Ready Player Me.

product.name: Avatar API
product.description: An API that provides an interoperability layer for avatars, improving performance and integration flexibility in virtual worlds, apps, and games.

product.name: Asset Manager and APIs
product.description: Tools and APIs for creators to upload, manage, and sell digital avatar assets such as clothes and outfits within the Ready Player Me platform.
